title: XOR Queries of Subarrays (Prefix XOR)

monster.name: Prefix Voidling
monster.title: Answerer of Range XOR Queries
monster.defeatQuote: Subarray XOR ranges answered in O(1) query time!

description: You are given an array `arr` of positive integers. You are also given the array `queries` where `queries[i] = [lefti, righti]`. For each query `i`, compute the XOR of elements from `lefti` to `righti`. Return an array containing the results.
starterCode:
def xorQueries(arr: list[int], queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def xorQueries(arr: list[int], queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
    prefix = [0] * (len(arr) + 1)
    for i, x in enumerate(arr): prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] ^ x
    return [prefix[r + 1] ^ prefix[l] for l, r in queries]
hints: Compute prefix XOR: range XOR [L, R] is prefix[R + 1] ^ prefix[L].
